name: Okaloosa County, FL
findings: Okaloosa County has 615 nonprofit organizations. 213 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 172 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Okaloosa County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Okaloosa County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 32% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?
